    MarketHintSignal.setStopCondition(BooleanSupplier stopCondition)
    Gates an engine-side stop (trailing or fixed) this signal arms on a strategy-supplied macro condition: the stop then fires only on a price crossing and while the predicate returns true, reproducing the ScalpingV2 "stop only in confirmed weakness" pattern as a config seam rather than per-strategy code.

    Sets the stop-loss trigger price on this signal, allowing a BuySignal to carry stop-loss configuration so the pipeline can auto-place a stop order after the buy fills.
